The Flats at Glenridge Station project (the “Project”) is a proposed six (6) story, two hundred forty five (245) unit, transit-oriented family affordable housing development to be located at 7011 Chesapeake Road, Hyattsville, Maryland 20784 and developed by Dominium Inc.
The target population will be families with household incomes at or below  sixty percent (60%) of the Area Median Income (“AMI”).
